authorization: 2026-09-28 user request to acquire/develop a proper QB margin distribution and supersede the quarantined spread process
supersession_scope: Separate QB full-game margin/cover research path replaces dependency on quarantined combined spread output; no unquarantine, default change or rewrite of old forecasts
one_structural_change: Add a QB-specific discrete residual margin law to unchanged fitted QB logistic and Ridge margin heads

distribution.residual: QB OOF observed final home margin minus QB OOF predicted home margin
distribution.support: numpy.rint(current QB Ridge home margin + residual - mean(training residual)); no clipping or truncation
distribution.weighting: Uniform within positive, negative and zero margin strata; masses (1-t)*p_qb, (1-t)*(1-p_qb), t
distribution.sigma_definition: Population SD of centered QB OOF residuals, reported in points; no assumed or backsolved sigma
distribution.candidate_mean: Exact weighted mean after rounding/reweighting; may differ from independent Ridge center
distribution.failure_policy: Abort for absent outcome stratum with positive mass, missing/duplicate/nonfinite data, mismatched reference or future training rows; no combined pool fallback
distribution.tuning: NONE; no market inputs, calibration slopes, line-dependent seeds or parameter search

history.source: Recovered original integrated-context archive; exact source hashes required
history.base_head_training: 2015 through year immediately preceding OOF season; original fit rule retained and QB OOF regenerated from saved features
history.each_evaluation_pool: Only QB OOF residuals from strictly earlier seasons; minimum 200 rows
history.deployment_pool: All QB OOF residuals 2019-2025, fixed once; no 2026 outcomes
history.limitation: History was inspected in earlier research; new screen is reused retrospective development, not prospective/PIT validation

baseline.sigma: Same prior-season QB residual population SD
baseline.distribution: Rounded normal; full integer support via normal CDF; no market fit

evaluation.primary: Paired margin CRPS, candidate minus discretized-normal reference
secondary: fixed-line three-way Brier and clipped log loss with zero-mass counts
evaluation.lines_role: Outcome-independent fixed probes only; not historical betting-line profitability or market calibration
evaluation.promotion: NONE from this retrospective screen; retain research HOLD until separately approved untouched prospective cohort

sampler.seed: first 16 hex of SHA256 canonical JSON of forecast identity, distribution identity and n; line and price absent

registration.design: Append experiment_queue in state.json and commit design before fitting
registration.forecast: New immutable margin writer record at actual current UTC, before start; original QB writer record remains unchanged

required_bindings: source cutoff and latest valid parent state
fitted QB residual law and sigma
independent deterministic replay and forecast-effect proof
